desc: Define the four diagonal directions and their corresponding clockwise 90-degree direction mapping.
Derive DP tables for maximum alternating continuation lengths starting at each cell for each diagonal direction.
Determine how to handle the expected `2/0` value based on segment length and turning-point parity.
Formulate the scan over every `1` start and every initial direction, combining straight and turned candidates.
Verify the implementation against all samples and boundary cases, including a single `1`, no `1`, no continuation, and turns at either endpoint.
